title: Power BI Report Development Standards
summary: Standards for building maintainable, fast Power BI semantic models and thin reports on a Fabric data platform: model settings, storage modes, naming, DAX, rebinding, endorsement and a pre-publish checklist.
audience: Power BI developers, analytics engineers, BI leads, report reviewers

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: What the standards cover, how the layers fit together, and where to start.

pages.title: Semantic model standards
pages.description: Storage mode choice, auto date/time and auto relationship settings, star schema, hiding, descriptions, calculation groups and PBIP/TMDL projects.

pages.title: Report design and performance
pages.description: Layout, theme, accessibility, mobile layout, drillthrough, query reduction, Performance Analyzer workflow and optimization levers.

pages.title: Naming, DAX and measures tables
pages.description: Naming rules for measures, columns and tables, DAX patterns, calculation groups and a step-by-step measures table in the UI and in TMDL.

pages.title: Rebinding reports to a new model
pages.description: Repoint a report to a different semantic model by REST, semantic-link-labs, PBIP or manual remap, with a schema diff and a verification matrix.

pages.title: Collaboration, endorsement and QA
pages.description: Shared semantic models with thin reports, endorsement and certification, Git and pipeline flow, change management and the pre-publish QA checklist.
